# What does one barber chair really earn, and should you cut, employ or rent it out?

> Free barbershop calculator: enter haircut, beard and combo prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per cut and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even cuts per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a barber. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
